description: Major water pipe burst near bathroom 2nd floor Hostel Block A causing water overflow into corridors.
incident_summary: Water pipeline burst detected near Hostel Block A 2nd floor bathroom causing corridor flooding.
root_cause: Aging underground plumbing pipe corrosion under heavy water pressure.
immediate_action: Shut off main water control valve near Hostel Block A immediately.
preventive_measures: Repair damaged pipeline and replace corroded pipe sections
Inspect nearby plumbing lines in Hostel Block A
Install warning caution signs around flooded floor areas

description: Sparking and short circuit in main switchboard inside AI Lab 302. Smoke visible near breaker.
incident_summary: Electrical short circuit and active sparking inside AI Lab 302 main breaker panel.
root_cause: Overloaded circuit breaker combined with loose terminal wire connections.
immediate_action: Evacuate Lab 302 and trip the main external isolator switch immediately.
preventive_measures: Replace faulty circuit breakers and damaged thermal insulation
Perform thermal imaging inspection on electrical panels across all computer labs
Enforce maximum load thresholds per laboratory circuit

description: Student collapsed with severe dizziness and dehydration during sports practice at ground.
incident_summary: Medical emergency involving student collapse and dehydration on sports ground.
root_cause: Heat exhaustion resulting from prolonged physical exertion under high temperature.
immediate_action: Administer first aid, ORS electrolytes, and move student to shade immediately.
preventive_measures: Provide shaded hydration stations near sports fields
Schedule intensive sports practice outside peak heat hours

description: Senior students intimidating 1st year students in Hostel Block B corridor after 10 PM.
incident_summary: Reported intimidation of 1st year students by seniors near Hostel Block B.
root_cause: Violation of anti-ragging policies during late night hostel hours.
immediate_action: Dispatch anti-ragging squad and night warden to Hostel Block B immediately.
preventive_measures: Increase night security patrols and warden inspection rounds
Conduct mandatory zero-tolerance Anti-Ragging awareness sessions

description: Laptop backpack containing laptop and wallet stolen from reading hall table while away for 10 mins.
incident_summary: Laptop theft reported from Library reading area.
root_cause: Unattended personal valuables in open public reading zone.
immediate_action: Review library entrance and reading hall CCTV footage timestamped 2:15 PM.
preventive_measures: Deploy smart lockers for temporary storage in reading halls
Install security awareness posters warning against leaving items unattended

description: Dense smoke and open flames coming from an electric scooter parked near student parking.
incident_summary: Vehicle fire involving electric scooter battery thermal runaway at Parking Area.
root_cause: Lithium-ion battery thermal runaway due to short circuit.
immediate_action: Sound campus fire alarm and utilize ABC dry chemical powder fire extinguishers.
preventive_measures: Designate isolated EV charging stations equipped with automatic sprinkler systems
Position ABC powder fire extinguishers every 20 meters in parking zones
